extensionDescription.message: Securely manages server-side Sieve filters with CRAM-MD5. Report issues at https://github.com/ecxod/sieve/issues

optionsDeveloperDescription.message: Show the Debugging button in a Sieve server's settings.

optionsSentryDescription.message: Optional. No error reports are sent without a DSN. Only HTTPS DSNs on sentry.zp1.net are accepted.

optionsSentryInvalid.message: Enter a valid HTTPS DSN for sentry.zp1.net.
